applies: only after the campaign completed (status completed with report_integrity.json); until then every launch and resume still refuses changed execution files
reason: Cool-down probes for windowed_pbt_v2 (scripts/training/pbt/planning/window_probe.py): with the new optional windowed_pbt_v2.probe setting (models/config.py), at every boundary that can copy members the runner (runner.py) trains a copy of each member for a few training jets at a lower LR and validates it, and the decision (planning/windowed_pbt_v2.py) ranks the members on these probe values. Without probe, which every recorded run and configuration uses, the files behave as before: the decision receives the unchanged generation, and the runner starts no probe (tests/test_window_probe.py, tests/test_windowed_pbt_v2.py). This record supersedes the earlier entries of the same files. The campaign ran on the frozen files; this record lets later work use the changed files without reporting drift for the completed study.
